run_BO_rolling_collect: run the BO rolling experiment collection script that runs Bayesian Optimization and Random Search over 30 epochs
run_opto_BO_optimize: run the opto BO optimizer with UCB acquisition function and GP regression model on a Rolling task
run_opto_random_search: run the opto RandomSearch optimizer with the same parameters as BO for comparison on a Rolling task
save_optimization_logs_h5: save optimization objectives and parameters to an h5 file using deepdish after each epoch
configure_opto_stop_criteria: configure the opto StopCriteria with maxEvals to control how many evaluations each optimizer runs
